summary: Daily Scoring Feature Testing Complete - All features working correctly. Backend API returns proper structure with days, day_labels, players, daily_totals, and period_total_fpts. Frontend tabs and components render correctly on Matchup, Roster, and Live Scoring pages. Day pill selection works. DailyGrid shows dashes for days without data as expected.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend endpoint GET /api/matchups/{league_id}/daily-scoring correctly returns all required fields: league_id, team_id, team_name, week, scoring_format, period_start, period_end, days, day_labels, players, daily_totals, period_total_fpts
Frontend useDailyScoring hook properly fetches and manages daily scoring data state
DayPillStrip component correctly renders TOTAL + day pills with proper selection state
DailyGrid component correctly shows player rows with day columns and dashes (—) for empty days
All three view tabs on Matchup page (Matchup Totals, Daily Scores, Daily Grid) work correctly
Roster page Daily Scoring tab between Roster and Franchise Trophy Room tabs works correctly
Live Scoring page Daily Scoring tab in Fantasy Leaderboard section works correctly

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all UI components render and function correctly)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Daily scoring feature fully implemented and tested. API returns 0.0 for all days because there are no live_stats entries in the database for the current matchup period (Oct 7-13, 2025) - this is expected behavior. The frontend correctly renders empty state indicators (—) in the DailyGrid cells. All tab switching, component rendering, and API response structure verified working.
